spec:
Backlog research. Evaluate whether a small, fast classifier can propose which optional review lenses (see the lens-based default graph) apply to a goal at capture, from its title, spec and the repository's risk history, so add-goal suggests skips with reasons instead of the agent guessing. Compare against the coordinating agent's own judgement on a labelled set of past goals: agreement, false skips of a needed lens, cost and latency. Deliverable: a short report and a recommendation; no engine change unless the recommendation is adopted as a new goal. The old routing experiment this came from is closed.

Migrated from GitHub issue #502 after the engine reset (#740).
title: Research a fast classifier for choosing review lenses at capture
